texts.zh:
[doomslayer_knight.GetName]骑士从传送门中带来的恐怖大军击溃了我们的防御，征服了[fromfrom.GetName]！

被强大的异次元实体夺舍后，[doomslayer_knight.GetHimselfHerself]自号为[doomslayer_knight.GetTitle][doomslayer_knight.GetName]，[doomslayer_knight.GetHeShe]为[doomslayer_knight.GetHimHer]召唤了一支恶魔军队，并开始征服我们的星系！

很快，恒星系的各处开始涌现出更多的传送门，但现实的织构过于厚重。所有的奇点很快就坍缩了，将恶魔的军队与它们的家园位面隔绝开。[doomslayer_knight.GetFirstName]没有受到太大影响，并开始巩固[doomslayer_knight.GetHisHer]的势力根基，以便继续[doomslayer_knight.GetHisHer]的星系征服大业。
texts.en:
The horrors that Knight [doomslayer_knight.GetName] led through the portal have breached our defenses and conquered [fromfrom.GetName]!

Possessed by a major dimensional being and now titling [doomslayer_knight.GetHimselfHerself] as [doomslayer_knight.GetTitle] [doomslayer_knight.GetName], [doomslayer_knight.GetHeShe] has called upon [doomslayer_knight.GetHimHer] demonic forces to begin the conquest of our galaxy!

Additional portals briefly opened throughout the system, but the strain on reality was too great a burden. All the singularities soon collapsed, severing the demonic host from their home dimension. Undeterred, [doomslayer_knight.GetFirstName] is now consolidating [doomslayer_knight.GetHisHer] power base before proceeding with [doomslayer_knight.GetHisHer] plans of galactic conquest.
